{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy songwriting appeals to me, but it is not my first pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After You Should Be So Lucky, I would be interested in hearing more from the Tom Petty and Benmont Tench connection.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and guitar-driven rock right now than traditional pop interpretations.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this because Memphis makes another Boz Scaggs album especially relevant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Band of Brothers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a country-focused album on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Freedom: Atlanta Pop Festival; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in People, Hell & Angels makes live Hendrix appealing, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sons of Anarchy: Songs of Anarchy: Volume 2 Original Soundtrack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would rather hear a full album by an artist I follow than explore a television soundtrack today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Quiet About It: A Tribute To Jesse Winchester; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The singer-songwriter material sounds appealing, but I do not feel strongly enough to choose it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Django and Jimmie; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Blown Away suggests some country interest, but this traditional country pairing is not what I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Born To Play Guitar; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening, but I would leave this for a later visit."}
